title: Confusing
body: The app does help track money. But it’s confusing because it restricts my card and when I went to try and turn that off it logged me off and now it wants me to pay again even though I already paid for a whole year. So now I’m frustrated.

title: Paywall
body: I really don’t like how you gotta pay before at the very least getting a trial run. It’s giving money hungry. Doesn’t make sense for a BUDGETING app. It’s like 10 a month 🥲

title: Makes you pay money to save money
body: I was really excited to try this app because recently I’ve been struggling with knowing how much I have left after I pay my rent. However, I’m not going to pay a monthly fee to use an app that’s supposed to be helping me save money and know what I can spend. Especially because the starting is $10 monthly and even though that doesn’t seem like a lot it truly is a lot when you’re on a tight Budget.

title: No Free Version :(
body: Seems like a great app, just wish there was a way to use some version for free and not HAVE to pay to use it.

title: Pay to Save Money? What a Joke.
body: You can’t even explore the app without getting stuck behind a paywall. They make you sign up and hand over your email just to find out you can’t use anything without paying. At least offer a free tier so people can actually try the app before committing to a subscription. Instead, it’s just another company collecting emails and charging people before they even know what they’re getting. Absolutely ridiculous.

title: Defeats the whole purpose
body: It doesn’t make sense to have to pay for an app that is supposed to helping you budget monthly payments and save money. It was very disappointing that there isn’t even a lesser option for free, you can only use the app if you pay for it.

title: This changed my view on budgeting
body: My favourite app to open up I love how the bills are laid out and the simplicity of the app just everything I need ☺️

title: Best pricing in its class
body: At $9.99, monbark is the most affordable premium budgeting app out there. I used YNAB and Monarch but they were charging 14.99 a month 😭 and was confusing for me. I like the simple layout of monbark I feel like I know what I’m spending now 💗 thank you I have been needing this.

title: Simpler way to budget
body: Monbark makes managing my money simple. I love seeing how long my money will last and what I can safely spend. Clean, easy, and actually helpful!

title: 5 Stars — Incredible value for what you get!
body: Seeing people complain about the $9.99/month price tag makes no sense when you look at other apps. Monbark delivers top-tier feature parity with apps like Monarch Money ($14.99/mo) and YNAB ($14.99/mo) at a significantly lower price point. If you want a powerful, clean, and reliable budget tracker without paying $100+ a year, Monbark is hands down the best value on the market right now.

Monbark has made managing my money so much easier. I really like how simple and easy to understand everything is, especially being able to see how long my money will last and what I can safely spend. The app is clean, straightforward, and actually helps me stay on top of my spending. Definitely worth trying if you’re looking for an easier way to manage your budget!
